it: \bRaffaello non perderà mai contro di te.

id: \bBugsy is ten times tougher then me.
en: \bBugsy is ten times tougher then me.
it: \bRaffaello è dieci volte più forte di me.

id: \bI'm just as good. I can be the Gym Leader for you.
en: \bI'm just as good. I can be the Gym Leader for you.
it: \bSono bravo quanto lui. Posso farti io da Capopalestra.

id: \bBugsy uses Bug type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Fire, Flying, and Rock types.
en: \bBugsy uses Bug type Pokémon. They are weak aganst Fire, Flying, and Rock types.
it: \bRaffaello usa Pokémon di tipo Coleottero. Sono deboli contro i tipi Fuoco, Volante e Roccia.

id: \bThey are strong against Psychic, Grass, and Dark. Fighting, Grass, and Ground also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Psychic, Grass, and Dark.  Fighting, Grass, and Ground also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Psico, Erba e Buio. Anche Lotta, Erba e Terra non fanno molti danni.

id: \bMy research is going to make me a leader on Bug- type Pokémon! Let me demonstrate what I've learned from my studies in a battle.
en: \bMy research is going to make me a leader on Bug- type Pokémon! Let me demonstrate what I've learned from my studies in a battle.
it: \bLe mie ricerche faranno di me un'autorità sui Pokémon di tipo Coleottero! Lascia che ti mostri in una lotta ciò che ho imparato dai miei studi.
\bRaffaello: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Alveare.

id: \bTM81 contains X-Scissor. It's a powerful Bug attack.
en: \bTM81 contains X-Scissor. It's a powerful Bug attack.
it: \bLa MT81 contiene Forbice X. È un potente attacco di tipo Coleottero.

id: \bBugsy: Bug types may be considered weak, but they are one of the most reliable.
en: \bBugsy: Bug types may be considered weak, but they are one of the most reliable.
it: \bRaffaello: I tipi Coleottero saranno anche considerati deboli, ma sono tra i più affidabili.
